prompt: A spectacular, premium, dark-mode web application dashboard for a fitness trainer. The aesthetic is strictly minimalist and gothic. Deep black backgrounds, stark white and muted gray typography. No neon colors, no generic gradients. Very serious, hardcore, and elegant. Left sleek vertical sidebar for navigation. Large top header welcoming the trainer with stark, elegant gothic-inspired sans-serif typography. Below, a highly visible 'Urgent Tasks' section highlighting pending athlete routines with sharp, rigid borders and deep shadows. On the right, an elegant e-commerce inventory grid showing fitness supplements in dark, moody photography. High-end UX/UI, architectural and brutalist minimalism mixed with gothic elegance.
